title: Optimizer Executor: staged validation, traffic probes, and approval gates for auto-applied Optimize suggestions
creator: Ava Chen
description: Implement an "Optimizer Executor" responsible for safely applying Optimize recommendations (batching and caching config changes) with staged validation, traffic probes, and human approval gates. The executor must: 1) translate Optimize recommendations into executable config diffs (runtime batching/window sizes, prefix caching rules, cache TTLs, quantization hints); 2) run non-invasive validation (dry-run config checks, unit probe jobs) in an isolated canary environment; 3) perform a staged traffic injection (shadow or low-percent live canary) with golden-metric monitoring (p90 latency, token cost, failure rate, semantic drift signals) and statistical significance checks; 4) provide an approval workflow for risky changes (cost delta >20% or latency increase >10%) and attach a clear rollback plan; 5) implement automatic rollback triggers (slo breaches, error budget consumption, anomaly detectors) and a fast manual fallback endpoint; 6) emit auditable events (who/when/why) for Private/Dedicated customers. Key constraints: preserve latency SLOs, limit single-step cost swings, and ensure low blast radius for per-customer configs.
acceptance_criteria: Executor converts Optimize suggestion JSON into a config diff and a readable summary within 5s
Canary runner can apply diffs to a shadow pool and run synthetic probes without impacting production traffic
Staged rollout supports at least three phases: shadow, 1% live, 10% live with automated metric checks between phases
Auto-rollback triggers when p90 latency or failure rate degrades beyond configured thresholds; rollback completes within 60s and is auditable
Approval-required flag set for changes exceeding configured risk thresholds; approver can accept/decline from Console with an audit trail
Unit + e2e tests cover translation, canary apply/rollback, and approval flows; CI gating exists on PRs touching executor code
Telemetry emitted for each apply attempt: config diff id, canary phase results, metrics delta, decision outcome
tasks: Design config diff format and schema (optimize-suggestion-v2) - @Lucas
Build dry-run validator and linter for candidate diffs
Implement canary runner with shadow and low-percent live injection modes
Hook metric collectors (console/grafana endpoints) and implement statistical tests (A/B KS + bootstrap)
Add approval workflow endpoints in Console + backend hooks
Implement auto-rollback engine and circuit-breaker with cooldown windows
Create e2e test harness and synthetic probe scenarios
Prepare runbook and incident playbook for failed rollouts
comments: 2025-02-14 Ava Chen: Kickoff — scoped executor MVP to support batching and KV prefix cache changes only. Prioritize minimal blast radius and fast rollback paths.

2025-02-19 Lucas Patel: Spike done — validated that shadow deploy against a duplicated pool is feasible without infra changes. Found gap: current runtime doesn't expose live per-request cache TTL toggles; need a small runtime flag endpoint (ENG-22600).

2025-02-24 Priya Nair (PM): Decision — require approval for any change with estimated token-cost delta > 20% or p90 latency change > 10%. Lower-risk changes (<=20% cost reduction) may be auto-applied with canary validation.

2025-02-28 Engineering sync: Trade-off discussion — longer canary windows increase confidence but delay savings. Opted for phase lengths configurable per suggestion with sensible defaults (shadow=1h, 1%=30m, 10%=2h).
2025-03-03 Design review (Marta Ruiz): UX note — approval screen must surface: affected routes, sample prompts, expected cost delta, recommended rollback variant, and links to PR/Design docs.
2025-03-05 Lucas Patel: PR opened (github.com/redwood/infer/pull/8943) — implements diff translation + basic shadow apply. Tests included. Needs approval-workflow API merge (backend team).
